answer_1.quote: We take machine translation as the testbed. We conduct experiments on five datasets of varied language pairs and training data sizes, including WMT14 English-German ... WMT14 English-French ... WMT18 English-Finnish ... WMT14 Chinese-English ... WMT16 Romanian-English.

answer_2.quote: We report detokenized case-sensitive BLEU ... implemented by SacreBLEU, and also show tokenized case-sensitive BLEU with multi-bleu.perl for ablation studies.
